goal: Treat conversation as an active debugging control plane
body: Product principle from Dave: NouGen should make infrastructure debugging feel conversational. While the user is simply chatting, the fleet can inspect live state, isolate failures, create repair legs, preserve findings, and continue the conversation without forcing a mode switch into a separate ops console. Preserve this as a UX and architecture direction: chat is not just an interface over the system, it is a control plane into the system. Done when this principle informs future tool design, status surfaces, and relay behavior.

relay.note: Blade claiming: Embedding Conversational Active Debugging Control Plane principle into local runtime and tools
